experiments.title: Cascade containment
experiments.evidence: 480 workflows independently verified. Invalid-action escapes: 10/60 ungated versus 0/60 full containment. Clean success 51/60 (85%) missed the frozen 90% floor.
experiments.next: Completed: five-chapter report and independently verified evidence available. Replication and redesign require a new protocol.
